items.title: Product-Led Growth: The Definitive B2B SaaS Strategy
items.author: Lenny's Podcast / Wes Bush
items.description: Deep dive into how Slack, Calendly, and Zoom built PLG motions. Covers product-qualified leads, freemium pricing, and viral loops specific to B2B enterprise.

items.title: Marty Cagan — EMPOWERED: Ordinary Teams, Extraordinary Products
items.author: Marty Cagan (SVPG)
items.description: Marty Cagan on how to build empowered product teams in large B2B organizations. Covers the shift from project to product, team topology, and leadership behaviors.

items.title: B2B SaaS Pricing: Frameworks That Work
items.author: Kumar Madhavan
items.description: Walkthrough of usage-based, tiered, and per-seat pricing models. Includes case studies from Stripe, Twilio, and Snowflake on packaging and monetization strategy.

items.title: Jason Fried — Shape Up: Stop Running in Circles
items.author: Jason Fried (37signals / Basecamp)
items.description: Basecamp's shape-up methodology explained by the founder. Six-week cycles, appetite-based scoping, and betting tables — highly applicable to B2B product teams.

items.title: Enterprise Sales for Product Managers
items.author: Shiven Ramji (ex-Microsoft)
items.description: How B2B PMs should think about enterprise sales cycles, proof-of-concepts, RFPs, procurement, and stakeholder mapping. Real examples from Azure and Office 365.

items.title: Teresa Torres — Continuous Discovery at Scale
items.author: Teresa Torres
items.description: How to scale opportunity solution trees across multiple B2B product teams. Covers discovery cadence, cross-team alignment, and outcome-driven roadmaps.

items.title: NPS vs CSAT for B2B SaaS: Which Metric Matters?
items.author: Gainsight / Pulse Podcast
items.description: Breakdown of when to use NPS vs CSAT in B2B contexts. Covers enterprise customer health scoring, churn prediction, and survey design for low-response-rate environments.

items.title: Building a B2B Product Strategy That Actually Works
items.author: Harvard Business Review / Linda K. Gorchels
items.description: Harvard Business Review on B2B product portfolio strategy. Covers platform plays, solution bundling, and managing multi-product roadmaps in enterprise settings.

items.title: API Product Management for Platform Teams
items.author: Kin Lane (Postman)
items.description: Managing APIs as products in B2B platform organizations. Covers API design-first, developer experience, versioning strategy, and API monetization.

items.title: Don't Shave That Yak! — Product & Engineering at Google
items.author: David Wong (Google)
items.description: Talk about how Google's B2B platform teams prioritize and communicate. Lessons on saying no to scope creep and keeping enterprise products focused.

items.title: Pricing Metrics That Matter for B2B SaaS
items.author: Kyle Poyar / OpenView
items.description: Deep dive on net dollar retention (NDR), expansion MRR, time-to-value, and logo churn. Benchmarking data across hundreds of B2B SaaS companies.
